title: One-step simulation with an appended memory tape
statement: Let $A$ be a memory-augmented register program, let $l_0$ be its start label, let $D$ be a decider with initial-state map $q_0$, and let $\beta$ be a Boolean value. For a configuration $c$ of the corresponding deterministic compiled machine, suppose that no nonhalting state of $c$ enables a memory instruction of $A$. Then, for any memory-tape contents $M$ and head position $p$, one step of the memory-augmented compiled machine from the configuration obtained by appending that tape equals the configuration obtained by taking one step of the deterministic compiled machine from $c$ and then appending the unchanged memory tape and head position.
